title: Activation of thyroid hormone receptors α and β by perfluoroalkyl carboxylic acid revealed by in vitro and in silico methods
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00978B, Paper
Weichao Wu, Fanglin Hu, Kun Xie, Ziyi Chen, Jintian Li, Li Fan, Minjie Li, Xinyi Zhou, Liang-Hong Guo
PFCAs including PFHxA, PFNA, and PFDA activated thyroid hormone receptor (TR) pathways, whereas PFHpA did not. The potency of TR-mediated activation followed the order of PFNA (C9) > PFHxA (C6) > PFDA (C10).
